meta.coverage_note: Phase 3E adds a reviewed-promotion importer and manual review batch so confirmed discovery candidates can enter the open feed safely.
meta.accuracy_policy: Only official/official-like national government and government-related sources are included in open roles. Gmail/WhatsApp/payment-request adverts are rejected into the watchlist, not shown as open roles.
limitations: PSCIMS active adverts are official central public-service records; review details on PSCIMS before applying.
MyGov/GAA is used as a discovery layer; items go to discovery_queue.json until cross-checked with the hiring institution.
KSG portal records are retained from the current actual snapshot and require cross-checking before submitting sensitive documents.
Most MDA/parastatal sources are registered but not yet fully scraped until exact official vacancy URLs are confirmed.
